name: Attraction
overview: Scripture reveals that attraction is closely tied to God's design for relationships and holiness. Genesis 2:24 emphasizes the union of man and wife as one flesh, highlighting the God-ordained bond in marriage. At the same time, Leviticus 18:22 clearly forbids same-sex relations as contrary to God's law. Proverbs counsels believers to guard their hearts diligently to avoid the allure of sinful temptation, such as the enticement of a strange woman (Proverbs 4:23; 6:24). Jesus' temptation in the wilderness (Matthew 4:1) reminds us that attraction can be a battlefield, and Matthew 19:12 acknowledges that some may choose celibacy for the sake of the kingdom, underscoring the importance of submitting attraction to God's purposes.
